reviews.comment: Dr. Hand is an incredibly caring professor that wants you to understand the material. He was incredibly fair as far as grading went, and made sure that he only gave tests on information he knew we 100% ready for. The only negative thing I can think of is that he is sometimes incredibly hard to reach via email. Otherwise, 10/10 professor.

Dr. Hand rocks!!! I have never met a more caring and kind prof. He never let us take an exam without at least two days of review first. Practice exams about 90% the same as real exams. Final was super simple. SO nice and funny! He's a little hard to access out of class email wise, but if this class were in-person it wouldn't be an issue.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Took online during covid so I didn't get a great chance to know him. Gave everyone As at end of the semester Be willing to commit to understanding content or the quizzes can be confusing Hes older so communication online may be difficult Grade distribution heavily skews towards As Cool guy overall No complaints

Dr. Hand struggles with online learning due to his age, but he is a funny and caring professor. He sometimes gets frustrated by the idea of technology which seems like he is angry at the class but it is not.

Dr. Hand rocks! The class is based on three tests, two regular and a final. Although each is worth the same amount of your final grade. He prepares you well for the tests. He won't give you a numeric grade, only a letter, although if you attend class and pay attention, A's are not super hard. He also listens to the best music and has good lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--TEST HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: practice tests are EXACTLY the test and he goes through them the class before so you should have all the test answers before the test
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
